def time_difference_across_zones(hh1, mm1, offset1_minutes, hh2, mm2, offset2_minutes):
    utc1 = hh1 * 60 + mm1 - offset1_minutes
    utc2 = hh2 * 60 + mm2 - offset2_minutes
    return utc2 - utc1
